key_impacts: More than one million people displaced.
At least five million people affected across Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Maldives, India, Thailand, Seychelles, and Myanmar.
Many hospitals and health centres destroyed or damaged; health workers among the victims.
Water supplies disrupted and contaminated; sanitation and sewage treatment facilities damaged.
evidence_snippets: 26 December 2004 a 9.0 earthquake struck west of northern Sumatra, triggering a powerful tsunami.
Death toll exceeded 280,000; more than one million persons were displaced.
Mosquito control in Banda Aceh, Indonesia, where some 200,000 homes have been sprayed.
